name: Nature Sounds
description: Pure field recordings, synthesized: no melodies, no beats, just places. Spring rain on new leaves, a thunderstorm that crosses the sky, a mountain stream, the sea on a shingle shore, a summer night, a campfire, the dawn chorus, wind on a high ridge, rain under a forest canopy, a sea cave, a meadow at noon and a frozen lake. Every sound is placed around you, so headphones help, and every random choice is seeded: change the Seed box for a different day in the same place.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Spring Rain
sketches.description: Soft rain on new leaves, drops falling from the branches at random points around you, a blackbird singing through the shower and thunder far away.

sketches.name: Thunderstorm
sketches.description: Eight bars of a storm: it builds on your left, breaks right over your head and rolls away behind you. The rain swells and fades, the gusts are wide and the gutter starts overflowing.

sketches.name: Mountain Stream
sketches.description: A clear stream runs past you from left to right, pebbles knock in the current, a dipper calls from a rock and a waterfall roars somewhere behind the trees.

sketches.name: Ocean Shore
sketches.description: Waves on a shingle beach: the surf rolls in, the stones rattle as each wave draws back, sea spray hisses in both ears and gulls wheel slowly overhead.

sketches.name: Summer Night
sketches.description: A warm night in the open: crickets in the grass on both sides, close chirps scattered around you, frogs at a pond behind you and an owl calling far off to the left.

sketches.name: Campfire
sketches.description: A fire crackling right in front of you, logs settling now and then, crickets in the dark and a light wind moving through the trees around the clearing.

sketches.name: Dawn Chorus
sketches.description: The first light in a woodland: birds singing from all around you, each in its own place, a lark crossing high overhead, a dove cooing behind you and a stream far off.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// The dawn chorus: each bird has its own place around you
robin: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.24)
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(60).elevation(25).distance(4).gain(.2)
thrush: s("bird").slow(5).azimuth(150).distance(6).gain(.16)
blackbird: s("bird").slow(7).azimuth(-120).elevation(10).distance(7).gain(.14)

// A lark crossing high overhead, gliding between positions
lark: s("bird").slow(4).azimuth(saw.range(-90, 90).slow(16)).elevation(50).distance(8)
  .posglide(.5).gain(.14)

// A dove cooing behind you on the left
dove: note("<[~ e4 [e4 c4] ~] ~>").s("hum").azimuth(-150).distance(5)
  .attack(.05).release(.4).gain(.1)

// A stream far off, and the first breeze
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(80).distance(8).gain(.1)
breeze: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.15).gain(.05)

sketches.name: Windswept Ridge
sketches.description: High on a bare ridge: a strong wind, gusts whose brightness wanders from ear to ear, a lone pine creaking, grass hissing at your feet and a raven calling far below.

sketches.name: Rain Under the Canopy
sketches.description: Sheltering under thick trees: the rain is muffled by the leaves above, heavy drops fall through at random, a stream swells nearby and a bird sings from somewhere in the wet.

sketches.name: Sea Cave
sketches.description: Inside a sea cave: the waves boom through the rock, water drips from the roof at points around you, a trickle runs down the wall and the whole space rings like a church.

sketches.name: Summer Meadow
sketches.description: Noon in a hay meadow: grasshoppers all around, bees circling your head, warm wind in the long grass, a skylark high above and a brook at the bottom of the field.

sketches.name: Frozen Lake
sketches.description: A still winter afternoon on the ice: a cold wind, snow hissing across the surface, your footsteps crunching, and the ice booming and cracking far out across the lake.
